data.analysis_scope: typed sequential curve/grid/text analyses, POP and NSC tracing
data.validation: See docs/capabilities.md for implementation and validation scope.
data.runtime_availability: 未连接时不判定许可或本机任务可运行性。

property_pages.units: lengths in current lens units; angles follow native page units

property_page_local_limitations.User: settings creation raises UILDEScatterData serialization exception; raw exception retained
property_page_local_limitations.BSDF: local file selector can return ABGF names and ignore BSDF assignment; mismatched resource list is rejected
property_page_local_limitations.ISScatterCatalog: requires an installed valid ISX catalog data file
property_page_local_limitations.FloatingAperture_to_None: native success can retain FloatingAperture; actual type readback is required

solve_validation.runtime_checks: native support, return status and actual adopted mode are checked per request

scope.fixture_scope: Cooke controlled surface replacements and empty-system controls; see each baseline
scope.registry_note: Combination registry spans the stated fixtures; it is not a claim that all cells work in every model.

matrix.note: State/value/persistence checks and optical numeric checks are distinct levels.

zrd_wavelength_filter_validation.verified: Seven unconverted fixed wavelengths; matched DetectorPolar/DetectorRectangle/DetectorColor models in uniform N-BK7; closed intervals, shared/exact endpoints, empty selection and pagination
zrd_wavelength_filter_validation.known_difference: Installed 2024 R2 sample_3 fluorescence ZRD: converted rays pass X_WAVERANGE near 0.55 um despite independent segment wavelengths spanning 0.500-0.734 um; fine-band selection is not validated
native_paths_tested: Ray Database Reader (property and legacy wrappers)
zrd_wavelength_filter_validation.internal_root_cause: unconfirmed; no reliable native fine-band workaround established for the recorded sample_3 model
zrd_wavelength_filter_validation.selection_scope: native ray/path selection; returned segments are not individually filtered
zrd_wavelength_filter_validation.fallback: none; native filter expressions and results are preserved

verified_scope: flux/coherent Power: Watts/Lumens/Joules, source prefixes None/Milli
DetectorRectangle.vector_interference_status: Polarization=0 intentionally uses scalar intensity/geometric phase; flags 1/2 select local Ex/Ey, separately verified for orthogonal axial inputs
DetectorRectangle.coordinates: native spatial or angular matrix; coherent data uses detector normalization
DetectorRectangle.verification: See docs/nonsequential-validation.md for model-specific native evidence

verified_scope: radiometric Power under lumen sources; energy in joules; prefixes None/Milli
DetectorPolar.coordinates: rows azimuth, columns polar; local +Z polar axis, +X azimuth origin
DetectorPolar.verification: See docs/nonsequential-validation.md for model-specific native evidence

DetectorColor.coordinates: native x-fast pixels reshaped into rows Y and columns X
DetectorColor.spectral_scope: native spectral-bin centroid and RMS; no spectral power spectrum adapter
DetectorColor.verification: 1W, x-fast non-square pixels and spectral-bin centroid; official CIE1931 2deg XYZ/xy/u-prime/v-prime/lumens at 450/550/650nm, unequal three-line mixture and 360-830nm discrete/trapezoidal flat spectra; radiometric spectra remain separate

DetectorVolume.verification: N-BK7 catalog transmittance at 0.3um, bulk absorption and density per lens-unit^3; incident flux repeats over traversed voxels

DetectorSurface.coordinates: native triangular pixel rows; FastRayTrace can reorder pixels

geometry.pixel_index: one based; face and pixel radiometry cross-checked

DetectorSurface.verification: plane/spherical/annular, signed tilt/decenter, FastRayTrace off/on; centroid hits, area and global vertices, save/reload

ReverseRadianceDetector.reason: 官方23.2版本说明移除Reverse Radiance、REVR及相关Detector/Target；本机2024 R2不提供此能力。

parameter_ranges.availability: only native active writable cells; enumeration bounds are not a model support claim

wavefront_pupil_mapping.scope: axisymmetric focused, untilted/undecentered circular unobscured; angular Y fields, radial normalization, selected primary wavelength
wavefront_pupil_mapping.method: real chief/marginal-ray F-numbers and analytic apparent-display inverse; per-point raw OPD check
wavefront_pupil_mapping.invalid: null coordinates with reason for unsupported scope, aperture/ray failures or OPD mismatch
wavefront_pupil_mapping.limitation: non-primary wavelength mapping remains unverified; not a physical pupil-surface reconstruction

source_backed_nsc_dll_validation.scope: explicit installed-source parameter fixtures; other parameters require independent references

mixed_mode_objects.selector: nsc_surface: sequential NonSequential-component surface number; required in mixed mode
mixed_mode_objects.identity: (nsc_surface, object); ref_object and inside_of are group-local
mixed_mode_objects.coordinates: NSC group entrance coordinates; combine with get_surface_geometry(nsc_surface) for sequential global coordinates
mixed_mode_objects.trace_scope: NSC tracing and detector tools remain pure NonSequential only

surface_numeric_reference_scopes.OddAsphere: signed radial coefficients; cusp Sag only at vertex; smooth normals/refraction away from cusp
surface_numeric_reference_scopes.Biconic: unequal/swapped principal radii and conics; infinite X radius; Sag/normal/refraction
surface_numeric_reference_scopes.Conjugate: real/virtual/off-axis construction points; vertex branch distance equation and reflection
surface_numeric_reference_scopes.ABCD: separate X/Y first-order matrices on (height, l/n or m/n); geometric rays only, no OPD reference
surface_numeric_reference_scopes.RetroReflect: air/glass plane and MIRROR reverse propagation; raw sequential cosines distinguished from physical propagation
surface_numeric_reference_scopes.JonesMatrix: axial incidence, normalized X/Y/45deg/circular input; identity/linear/quarter-wave/real rotation; common phase removed with identity reference
surface_numeric_reference_scopes.extended_parameters: term participation, signed coefficients and normalization; supported Fixed/Variable/same-column pickup, protection and zos/zmx reload; see evidence

data.surface_type_scope_note: 原生可选枚举与上述受控模型数值范围分别解释；其他面型不自动视为已适配。

analysis_image_sources.native: existing_native_image_artifact_only; no general IAR bitmap export

pop_dll_adapters.parameter_metadata: ZOS-API first; known installed DLL UserParamNames queried in a bounded isolated no-window process on metadata failure
pop_dll_adapters.beam_and_receiver: native calls and identical-mode coupling verified for the three listed files

independent_field_reference.Ince-Gaussian-64.dll: p=m=2, even/odd, f0=0.05/0.1mm, w0=0.1mm: independent whole-waist irradiance and signed relative complex field; other orders/propagated phase pending

data.pop_coupling_definition: polarized receiver efficiency is a power-weighted mean of separately normalized component overlaps; not a single normalized vector inner product

tolerance_trial_status.verified_format: OpticStudio 2024 R2 Chinese Monte Carlo trial table
tolerance_trial_status.mapping: complete one-based trial IDs, zero-based row indices, displayed criterion precision and traceable count must agree
tolerance_trial_status.failed_trials: explicit untraceable trials excluded from moments and counted as failed in requested-sample yield; raw finite sentinel retained
tolerance_trial_status.unrecognized_format: SAMPLE_STATUS_UNAVAILABLE when failures cannot be mapped
